title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
title_zh: 当评审者落后时：面向持续智能体自我改进的评分标准与执行框架协同演化

paragraphs.en: 提出RuHarness框架，让评分标准与执行框架协同演化，实现智能体在未见任务上的持续自我改进。 Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse agent tasks and backbone models show that RuHarness outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, particularly on unseen held-out tasks. Further analyses show that adaptive rubric prioritization tracks shifting weaknesses and supports more sustained improvement and stable generalization across evolution rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 提出RuHarness框架，让评分标准与执行框架协同演化，实现智能体在未见任务上的持续自我改进。自主智能体日益依赖于围绕大语言模型（LLM）管理交互、记忆、工具和执行的执行框架。 尽管最近的工作已开始从执行经验中演化这些执行框架，但用于指导演化的监督信号往往仍相对静态，难以追踪各轮次中不断变化的行为弱点，并可能限制对未见任务的泛化能力。 为解决这一问题，我们提出RuHarness，一个用于智能体持续自我改进的评分标准——执行框架协同演化框架。 RuHarness从执行轨迹中持续发现并重新评估行为准则，优先处理最相关的未解决弱点，并利用它们指导有针对性的执行框架更新，同时保持任务目标不变。 在多种智能体任务和骨干模型上的大量实验表明，RuHarness优于强大的执行框架演化基线，尤其是在未见过的留出任务上。 进一步分析表明，自适应的评分标准优先级排序能够追踪不断转移的弱点，并在演化轮次中支持更持续的改进和更稳定的泛化。
